title: F11 FULLSCREENS THE PLAYER 2 WINDOW
why: Found by the whole-game bug hunt of 2026-10-08. On one PC with two screens, F11 in the player 2 window never fullscreened it, his report of 2026-10-03. That window hands every key to the player 1 window, F11 included, so its own fullscreen toggle never ran, and the player 1 window ran the toggle instead: a fullscreen player 1 dropped out of fullscreen. F11 now stays in the window it was pressed in and fullscreens that window. Every other key still goes to player 1.
now: F11 in the player 2 window now fullscreens that window and leaves the player 1 window alone.
